instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: A 32-year-old client with confirmed Guillain-Barre syndrome after recent Campylobacter enteritis has progressive quadriparesis, labile blood pressure, tachycardia, ineffective cough, unilateral absent gag reflex, FVC 1.6 L (19 mL/kg), and MIP -26 cmH2O. He speaks only a few words at a time and is diaphoretic while receiving IVIG in the ICU. Complete the bow-tie by selecting the most likely condition, two priority actions, and two parameters to monitor.
